convert_networkx_to_data_dict: convert a networkx OrderedMultiDiGraph to a data dict with numpy arrays for nodes, edges, and globals
build_graphs_tuple_from_networkxs: build a graphs.GraphsTuple from an iterable of networkx OrderedMultiDiGraph instances
split_graphs_tuple_to_data_dicts: split a graphs.GraphsTuple into a list of individual data dictionaries per graph
batch_data_dicts_to_graphs_tuple: batch a list of graph data dictionaries into a single graphs.GraphsTuple with stacked numpy arrays
extract_subgraph_from_tuple: extract a subgraph or subbatch from a graphs.GraphsTuple using an integer index or slice
